g.text: SysMon - Spawn LLM Server Sequence Diagram
Admin (Tier 1, 2 or 3) opens the LLM console,
pastes a HuggingFace model repository, sets context
length, CPU/GPU split and server port, then clicks Spawn.
[Caller may not spawn LLMs or use the chosen Compute Group]
[Data invalid (empty modelRepo, bad port, missing fields)]
After an error the Frontend shows the reason.
The admin may correct the form (port, model,
Compute Group) and send the request again.
